verdict: GENERALIZATION TEST (bacteria -> eukaryote): on S. cerevisiae (iMM904 GEM vs Giaever-2002 DEG2001 essential set), FBA single-gene-deletion essentiality is ENRICHED for experimental essentiality among the model's metabolic genes: OR 4.65 (Fisher one-sided p 1.64e-10), precision 0.364, recall 0.315, AUROC 0.6097. Contingency {'both': 40, 'FBA_only': 70, 'exp_only': 87, 'neither': 708}. Gate (OR>3 AND p<0.01): PASS. SCOPE: essentiality-enrichment only; in-silico FBA vs a published deletion set (not wet-lab); curated model is still a model; recall bounded by metabolic subproteome; MODEL EUKARYOTE (S. cerevisiae), not a direct C. albicans claim — but the essential metabolic machinery is shared with fungal pathogens.
